description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeaveAPI in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, focusing on API interactions such as retrieving all leave records and handling unimplemented operations.

classes.name: LeaveAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, using mock services and fixture data to validate API behavior.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all leave records via the LeaveAPI, using data provider for parameterized testing.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data loaded from a YAML file for testing the 'getAll' API method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method in LeaveAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for creating a leave are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Ensures that the getOne method throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that validation rules for fetching a single leave are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetDelete
methods.description: Checks that the delete method throws a 'not implemented' exception.
